style: rain-slicked cyberpunk twilight painting with glowing cyan canals, warm lantern reflections, and dark slate
rules: Each item belongs to a unified tabletop cosmetic collection sharing the exact same palette, brushwork, and motif. No text, letters, numbers, logos, or borders.
spare: an extra painting in the same style: a wide serene tabletop playmat evoking Neon Harbor

items.subject: a wide serene tabletop playmat evoking Neon Harbor. A wide 16:9 tabletop playmat with a calm, low-contrast textured center so playing cards read crisply over it, and painterly theme accents along the outer edges.
a painterly fantasy portrait bust of Aether Courier in the theme of Neon Harbor. A centered bust portrait medallion subject with dramatic workshop lighting and clean silhouette.

an adorable small magical tabletop companion creature, Cyber Koi, matching Neon Harbor. A charming tabletop companion creature in full-body view centered with breathing room around it on a deep moody background.
a circular ornamental portrait frame medallion titled Circuit Rim in the style of Neon Harbor. An ornate circular portrait border motif with clean dark interior so an avatar sits inside it.
an ornate vertical Command-Zone card border frame titled Neon Command matching Neon Harbor. An ornate vertical rectangular border frame for a commander card slot with a calm dark interior center.

the BACK of a playing card in the same style: a symmetrical ornamental design (it is seen upside down too) with a central emblem drawn from this set's theme, framed by a painted border; no logo, no oval, no five dots, no lettering
